profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer | Passionate about Equity and The Environment | Ruby on Rails, Typescript, React.js
profile.summary:
Full-stack software engineer. Enthusiastic about equity, service, and bettering the planet. Frequently found hiking.

My prior experience as a team leader and project manager in software development taught me the big picture of what a team can do. My engineering background, technical project management experience, and passion building a better future have led me to pursue a career in software development 

Undefined goals and uncharted territory don’t scare me, whether it’s a learning new coding language, learning how to get a non-profit off the ground, or hiking a new trail. My whole-brained engineering training taught me to think curiously and critically about the world - I absolutely love digging into problems and solving them creatively.  I love to see my teams succeed - as a project manager of a software team deploying a new product, as a band member prepping for a gig, as a leader within a grass-roots group to save a beloved music school, and now as a software developer, I love to ensure every individual on every team I'm a part of is successful in what they do.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Assumed ownership of an internal host report ingestion and mapping tool with downstream billing side effects, including implementing new features to incorporate supplier-generated reports into the customer billing cycle. Mapped 80% of existing customer ingestions to new report format.
- Enhanced members’ understanding of their billing breakdown and what enrollment in community solar means for their monetary and energy savings.
- Internally segmented and clarified what plans each member can be enrolled in, how we should bill them, and how we should interact with their utility provider and solar farm. Collaborated with member services to introduce and enroll small business accounts as a customer type.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Engineered solutions in our Rails monolith against a Postgresql database, a Typescript/React front end,
and a GraphQL middleware layer to ensure community solar members have a smooth experience navigating their dashboard and are able to easily and intuitively make all necessary plan, account, and billing setting updates.
- Contributed to rewrite of the entire user dashboard supporting a significant account model migration, including deprecating and refactoring various flows, and supporting a complicated and iterative rollout to hundreds of thousands of accounts by customer account type.
- Audited and updated all application notifications, including decoupling from highlights, transitioning to a new activation method, integrating a newly-extracted application, and creating 5 new notification types to ensure that customers understand the full impact and benefits of our product via touch points such
as dashboard notifications and email.
- Addressed technical and process gaps, including creating a testing and how-to doc for all our applications prior to dashboard handoff to other teams and implementing and championing agile and RCA processes.

positions.title: Software Engineering Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supported 12 students in Object-Oriented programming bootcamp with Ruby on Rails and Javascript/VueJS. Reviewed code, provided feedback on programming assignments, and assisted with student understanding of course material.
positions.insights: Skills: Peer Reviews · Ruby · Back-End Web Development · Ruby on Rails · Training · Microsoft SQL Server · PostgreSQL · Vue.js

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
- Fundamental in creating a program designed to elevate the academic and professional interests of
Black and Latinx recent high school graduates interested in pursuing computer science majors in college. Foundation aims to disrupt professional, financial, and racial equity gaps present in computer science fields through equipping students with skills to thrive in the tech industry via scholarship assistance, paid internships, individualized mentors, top-tier tutors, and networking opportunities.
- Executed vision of founders and board members from inception through the successful graduation of the first two cohorts of 10+ participants.
- Directed and managed daily operations, created and maintained website, listserv, curriculum tools, and CRM, managed mentor and tutor program, created and delivered professional development content, and led recruitment campaigns including outreach to over 50 Chicago-area high schools. Designed and implemented participant application and interview process using rubric for equitable selection.
- Set short and long term strategic goals to achieve Seneca’s mission and growth objectives to double number of participants with first corporate partner, increase the number of corporate partners by 3, and launch new cohorts with additional corporate partners, as well as hire additional staff and double the number of volunteers necessary order to support this growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Student Outreach · Non-profit Management · Project Management · Professional Development Programs · Non-profit Program Development

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
- Drove the full lifecycle delivery of a highly-scalable and robust speech analytics platform from initial requirements through design, validation, and production deployment to replace third party tools for major customer pipelines.
- Managed agile/scrum project planning, web development, voice engineering, and data analytics
activities for a large cross-functional team, including prioritizing product/customer feedback, migrating products to Kubernetes, planning releases, unblocking hurdles, and coordinating the overall software and platform architecture with other teams.
- Implemented root cause/corrective action and customer support frameworks for continuous optimization of processes and prevention of production-impacting issues.
- Created and maintained design documents and architecture diagrams, and completed periodic architecture reviews and security audits against customer and national standards such as PCI-SSC, GDPR and SOC 2.
positions.insights: Skills: Root Cause Analysis · Agile Project Management · Technical Communication · Team Leadership · Microsoft SQL Server · Database Queries · Software Architecture

positions.title: Technical Manager
positions.description:
- Oversee quality and technical functions for entire manufacturing site.
- Develop, implement and support quality systems and process improvement projects and lead opportunities in process improvement, cost take-out efforts, safety enhancement and troubleshooting, support on-site R&D scale-up trials
- Provide root cause/corrective actions for customer complaints, lead quality improvement initiatives, lead continuous improvement projects through LSS analysis tools
- Continuous Improvement: 5S implementation, visual standards and PCS, provide coaching and training for WCOM teams,  Lead Set-up Time Reduction LSS Green Belt Team (co-leader; 30% set-up time improvement), Defect Reduction LSS Black Belt Team (co-leader; ongoing)
- Food Safety Team leader – led successful FSSC surveillance audit, customer audits, and internal quality systems audit
- SAP implementation key user for QM – develop quality data and MICs, provide SAP training to employees

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed, implemented and supported quality systems and process improvement projects and led opportunities in process improvement, cost reduction, safety enhancement and troubleshooting.
- Participated on leadership team, safety steering team, continuous improvement teams, black belt team, SAP preparation

positions.title: Business Process Improvement Engineer
positions.description:
- Was responsible for daily process control and continuous improvement projects, including technical troubleshooting, waste and quality control, and ongoing internal and external quality investigations.
- Developed Cost Take-Out file for use by 25+ plants, including extensive VBA programming, and conducted training for all continuous improvement and plant managers
- Established and implemented waste accountability procedure for all departments, including leading and coaching multiple cross-functional waste accountability teams and conducting training for all employees. Improved from 76% to 95% waste accountability.
- Progressive Quality WCOM Pillar, focused on waste improvement, pillar training and skill development – led defect reduction team to improve customer quality and reduce quality waste (total cost of defect reduced by 37%)
- Focused Improvement WCOM Pillar – co-led Speed Loss Reduction Team and created standards tracking tools and team deployments. Reduced department speed loss by 33%.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched and developed computer models to track energy use and assess and predict emissions associated with industrial food production for future cap-and-trade regulations. Heavy use of VBA and environmental regulation knowledge.
- Collaborated with manufacturers and policy makers to develop mathematical models to estimate life-cycle emissions and energy efficiency associated with industrial processing plants and discrete products within complex production environments.
- Assessed product-based benchmarks for the provision of emissions allowances to California plants under the cap and trade law. Incorporated analysis of mass and energy flows and exchanges among production processes.

company.name: ERSAL (Energy and Resource Systems Analysis Laboratory), Northwestern University

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Ecological Consequences of Polychlorinated Biphenyls 	
- Studied fundamental impacts of PCBs in biological and environmental systems at an increasing scale in local ecosystems
- Developed a testing and measurement strategy to comprehensively characterize ecotoxicity patterns of PCBs
- Optimized lipid-extraction technique and analyze data from experiments

company.name: Northwestern University, Department of Environmental Engineering

positions.title: R&D Manufacturing Intern
positions.description:
- Developed environmental screening benchmark model, including ISO and REACH requirements, for current/future products.
- Optimized product formulas to lower volatile organic compounds using Design Of Experiments methodology.
- Worked with lab team to resolve technical problems, optimize current product formulation, and test new research methods

positions.title: Research Assistant, Department of Environmental Engineering
positions.description:
- Designed and executed experiments in environmental wet lab to test applications of microbiology to water purification technology
- Examined function of electrochemical cells to develop a low-tech, practical and mobile water purification device
